'''Toonbuck Toora''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sy Myrthian/Legends|Sy Myrthian]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] representing the people of [[Sy Myrth/Legends|Sy Myrth]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] during the final decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] until she withdrew her planet from the Republic and pledged her support to [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku's]] [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] after the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]].

==Biography==
A [[Sy Myrthian/Legends|Sy Myrthian]] politician, Toonbuck Toora served in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] as the representative of her people and all of [[Sy Myrth/Legends|Sy Myrth]]. An idealist who had hoped to end corruption within her administration, Toora became jaded and cynical as time progressed and ultimately she embraced the culture of greed that permeated the elite on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Over her time in galactic politics, Toora became one of the most corrupt Republic politicians of the time. Dressing herself in fine linens and adorning her arm with an ever-present [[Toonbuck Toora's consort/Legends|consort]], Toora's wealth was beyond any she could have imagined and gladly made herself comfortable throughout her career.<ref name="db" />

Profiting greatly from investment in the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], Toora became one of the Federations more vocal supporters in the Senate at the time surrounding their [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invasion]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. While most of the Senate was divided, belonging either to the [[Core Faction/Legends|Core faction]] or to the [[Rim Faction/Legends|Rim faction]], Toora was autonomous and still influential, being a political ally of figures such as [[Orn Free Taa/Legends|Orn Free Taa]] of [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]], [[Edcel Bar Gane/Legends|Edcel Bar Gane]] of [[Roona/Legends|Roona]] and [[Passel Argente/Legends|Passel Argente]], the Magistrate of the [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]]. This group was a partidary of Senator [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] of Naboo, a relative newcomer to the political scene of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] who, nevertheless, had managed to grasp [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum's]] attention.<ref name="cod">''[[Cloak of Deception]]''</ref>

[[File:Toonbuck_Toora.png|thumb|left|Toonbuck Toora in the Galactic Senate.]]

Noticing that Valorum favored Palpatine, Toora questioned Palpatine about the advice he had been giving to the Chancellor. The Naboo was noncommittal, suggesting that he had only helped the Chancellor to grasp the bigger picture. By saying this, he surprised the Sy Myrthian and perked her interest, but he excused himself before answering any further inquiry.<ref name="cod" />

In [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]], Chancellor Valorum proposed the taxation of the until-then free trade zones. Toora visited the [[Coruscant Opera/Legends|Coruscant Opera]], like many other politicians of the time where she met with Palpatine to discuss politics. Attending a reproduction of ''[[The Brief Reign of Future Wraiths]]'', performed by a [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] company, she shared a balcony with her political allies when she learned from Senator Palpatine that he had suggested to the Chancellor that a part of the collected money could be invested in the growth of planetary systems in the affected areas. While senators of that region supported the idea, Toora and other delegates including [[Po Nudo/Legends|Po Nudo]] and [[Wat Tambor/Legends|Wat Tambor]] openly opposed to it. She was in luck when Palpatine proposed that the matter be resolved at a [[Eriadu Trade Summit|Trade Summit]] on [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]] and, once the Eriadu delegate accepted the idea, Toora was quick to second the motion.<ref name="cod" />

Following Palpatine's accession to the Chancellorship, Toora continued to be a vocal opponent of his policies over the next decade, criticizing his attempts to regulate the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild's]] operations in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. As a major [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|secessionist movement]] plagued the Senate, Toora was absent from the Senate for over a month before [[Secession of Sy Myrth|submitting]] her world's resignation from the galactic government via a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] proxy.<ref name="HNN45" /> Toora publicly gave her support to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] after being won over by [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku's]] promises of power. When the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] broke out, Toora remained faithful to the Confederate cause throughout the three year conflict.<ref name="EGTW" />

When the war came to a crashing end in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], Toora escaped with a small fleet as the Republic and the Confederacy collapsed and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] assumed absolute control over the galaxy. One of the last Confederate holdouts, the former senator had managed to reactivate a significant number of droids. Aboard her flagship, the ''[[Defiance's Banner]]'', Toora fought against the Empire on many fronts, losing ground at [[Charros IV/Legends|Charros IV]], [[Diado]], and [[Metalorn/Legends|Metalorn]] before eventually being cornered over the planet [[Trasemene]]. She was killed when the [[Sy Myrthian Insurrection|insurrection]] ended in the [[Battle of Trasemene]], where the Imperial [[Praetor-class Star Battlecruiser/Legends|''Praetor''-class Star battlecruiser]] [[Battalion (Praetor-class)|''Battalion'']] destroyed the cruiser.<ref name="EGTW" />

==Personality and traits==
A wide-mouthed Sy Myrthian with small eyes, Toonbuck Toora had three short beards growing from her chin. Neckless and squat-headed Toora lacked legs like all Sy Myrthians and instead achieved locomotion through the use of a single foot similar to other gastropods. Toora was corrupt, very rich and prone to luxury. Non-confrontational, she was also said to enjoy conspiracy.<ref name="cod" />

==Behind the scenes==
Toonbuck Toora was portrayed by [[Howard Swindell]] in [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''The Phantom Menace'']] and by special effects artist [[Hilton Howson]] in [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Attack of the Clones'']]. Toora was scripted to be in the Separatist war room scene on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] in ''Attack of the Clones'', but was digitally replaced by [[Rogwa Wodrata/Legends|Rogwa Wodrata]] because [[George Lucas]] was unsatisfied with Toora's mask.<ref>{{SWArchive|url=qa|text=''Star Wars'' Q & A}} - Episode II Lore - February 07, 2003</ref> She is still present in the novelization and the comic of ''Attack of the Clones''.

The novelization of [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)|''Attack of the Clones'']] misspelled her name as "Toonebuck Toora". According to her now defunct databank entry, Toora's name is derived from Live Action Animatronics Effects Supervisor [[Nick Dudman]]'s acquaintance's dog.

According to [[Leland Chee]]'s "[[Ask Lobot]]" article in ''[[Star Wars Insider 101]]'', "There has been some suggestion that the Toonbuck Toora we see on Geonosis was actually a [[Shi'ido]] shape-shifter involved in a duplicitous ploy to bring Sy Myrth to the Confederacy. In that scenario, the plot is ultimately foiled, leaving the planet firmly loyal to the Republic."
